question: Is a yogin liberated even while conducting all transactions?
premises: senses mind and intellect are restrained
desire fear and anger have departed
even while conducting all transactions he remains liberated
inference: A yogin whose senses, mind, and intellect are restrained and whose desire, fear, and anger have departed remains liberated even while conducting all transactions.
uncertainties: yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ is a long fused compound
plain_english: A sage with restrained senses, mind, and intellect, devoted to liberation, whose desire, fear, and anger have departed, is always liberated; such a yogin, even while conducting all transactions, is indeed liberated.
